In 2008, a TV news report did the simple math on the yearly flu shot that health officials never do in public.

3% of unvaccinated adults got the flu. 2% of vaccinated adults still got it anyway.

Which means, in the reporter's own words, "only one case of the flu was prevented for every 100 shots given." 🧵
